subject: Parachute plan to compress MAP security gates for LynxBank
messages:
From: Sean Gallagher <sean.gallagher@redwood.ai>
To: Sam Powers <sam.powers@lynxbank.com>
Cc: Kimberly Park <kimberly.park@redwood.ai>, Jordan Blake <jordan.blake@redwood.ai>
Date: Thu, 20 Aug 2026 16:03:00 +0000
Subject: Parachute plan to compress MAP security gates for LynxBank

Sam —

Thanks again for the conversation this morning. Based on your timeline and procurement window, attaching a lightweight 'parachute' MAP that compresses the usual evidence sprint while preserving reviewer confidence. The core idea: run a short, parallelized intake (SOC 2 package + SIG/CAIQ answers) while we finalize a targeted DPA redline and retention commitments.

High-level proposed onramp (3-week accelerated track):
- Week 0 (this week): kickoff + intake checklist; provide SOC 2 Type II report + CAIQ snapshot; procurement to share redlines.
- Week 1: evidence sprint — only high-value artifacts (security org chart, access controls, infra diagrams, retention policy excerpts).
- Week 2: traceability matrix + remediation/RCA for any gaps; DPA negotiation and e-sign.
- Week 3: acceptance review, signoff, and provisioning for a small pilot (hosted or dedicated).

Asks from our side to keep this compressed:
- Lynx to confirm procurement contact and priority items (PII residency vs. full EU residency).
- Procurement to return DPA redlines in 3 business days to enable DocuSign loop.
- If EU residency required for production, flag now — private deployment timelines change the cadence.

Attachments: MAP-Parachute-Plan-v1.xlsx (MAP timeline + owners); SOC2-archive-link.txt (link to our SOC 2 artifacts); traceability-matrix.csv (template).

I'll coordinate owners internally: Kimberly will run the evidence sprint; Jordan will lead DPA redline intake and HubSpot/contract updates. CC'ing both here.

If that looks workable, I can send a one-page intake form to procurement and loop legal.

Thanks,
Sean Gallagher
Senior Account Executive | Redwood Inference
sean.gallagher@redwood.ai | (415) 555-0123
[Attachment: MAP-Parachute-Plan-v1.xlsx (application/vnd.openxmlformats-officedocument.spreadsheetml.sheet)]
[Attachment: SOC2-archive-link.txt (text/plain)]

From: Sam Powers <sam.powers@lynxbank.com>
To: Sean Gallagher <sean.gallagher@redwood.ai>
Date: Mon, 24 Aug 2026 10:11:00 +0000
Subject: Re: Parachute plan to compress MAP security gates for LynxBank

Sean —

Appreciate the quick plan. A few clarifications from procurement/security side before we commit to the accelerated track:

1) SOC 2: we need the latest Type II report and the associated implementation narrative. Can you confirm the observation period?
2) SIG/CAIQ: we use the CAIQ as a checklist — can Kimberly provide a filled CAIQ + any open notes?
3) DPA: our legal team will likely push a few retention carveouts, especially around EU customer data; procurement@lynxbank.com is the contact for redlines.
4) Data residency: for pilot purposes we can accept hosted US regions, but production will need EU residency for EU customers. What is the delta on timelines if we require EU residency?

If you can deliver the SOC2 docs and a completed CAIQ by EOD Thursday, procurement will aim to get DPA redlines back within 3 business days. Also please include a one-pager explaining what artifacts will be provided versus what we need to request from our security team.

On the CAIQ: please indicate whether you have a CAIQ mapped to evidence artifacts (traceability matrix). That will speed reviewers.

Thanks,
Sam Powers
Director, IT Procurement | LynxBank
sam.powers@lynxbank.com

From: Kimberly Park <kimberly.park@redwood.ai>
To: Sean Gallagher <sean.gallagher@redwood.ai>, Jordan Blake <jordan.blake@redwood.ai>
Cc: Mina Haddad <mina.haddad@redwood.ai>
Date: Tue, 25 Aug 2026 08:42:00 +0000
Subject: Re: Parachute plan to compress MAP security gates for LynxBank

Sean / Jordan —

Quick notes from security/ops on compressing the intake:

- SOC 2: we can produce the Type II report + implementation narrative link (SOC2-archive-link.txt). Observation period ends 2026-05-31; that should be acceptable for procurement reviewers.
- CAIQ: we will deliver a filled CAIQ mapped to artifacts. I'll own the CAIQ and the traceability matrix so reviewers can see exact evidence per control.
- Evidence sprint scope: prioritize controls relevant to data residency, encryption, access management, and incident response. We should avoid asking them to review low-risk operational docs in the accelerated run.
- Retention buckets: propose we pre-commit to the following for the MAP (pilot): 90 days logs, 1 year derived telemetry, 7 years for contractual audit records (we can carve per-account in DPA). We'll call out EU residency as a toggle that moves provisioning to Private (adds ~6–8 weeks for infra and contract).

Jordan: once procurement shares the DPA redlines, I'll flag any divergent security asks that would block a pilot. If we get the DPA back within 3 business days (as Sean suggested), legal can do a quick review and push to DocuSign.

I'll start the CAIQ today and share a draft CAIQ+matrix by Wednesday EOD (PST).

—Kimberly
Kimberly Park
Head of Customer Security Engagements | Redwood Inference
kimberly.park@redwood.ai

From: Sean Gallagher <sean.gallagher@redwood.ai>

Cc: Kimberly Park <kimberly.park@redwood.ai>, Jordan Blake <jordan.blake@redwood.ai>, Mina Haddad <mina.haddad@redwood.ai>
Date: Fri, 27 Aug 2026 14:21:00 +0000
Subject: Re: Parachute plan to compress MAP security gates for LynxBank — confirmed intake and owners

Sam —

Thanks — this is helpful. Confirming the accelerated MAP commitments and owners so procurement/security have a single doc to follow. If procurement is OK with the 3-day DPA turn, we can hit your pilot window.

Mutual Action Plan (parachute MAP) — commitments and owners
- Deliver SOC 2 Type II + implementation narrative (Owner: Kimberly Park) — deliver by Thu 2026-08-27 EOD (SOC2-archive-link.txt).
- Completed CAIQ mapped to evidence + traceability matrix (Owner: Kimberly Park) — deliver by Wed 2026-08-26 EOD.
- DPA redline intake and negotiation (Owner: Jordan Blake) — procurement to send redlines to procurement@lynxbank.com; aim to return redlines in 3 business days; target DocuSign by Fri 2026-08-28.
- Data residency decision (Owner: LynxBank) — pilot OK in US hosted; production requiring EU residency -> Private deployment estimated +6–8 weeks from DPA sign.
- Evidence sprint (Owner: Kimberly Park) — focused artifacts only; sprint reviews scheduled Mon/Wed; remediation notes by Week 2.
- Acceptance review & pilot provisioning (Owner: Sean Gallagher) — provision small pilot within 5 business days of sign for hosted; Private provisioning timeline as above.

Related links: HubSpot deal (https://app.hubspot.com/deal/LYNX-2026-094), DPA draft via DocuSign (https://docusign.net/Lynx-DPA-2026).

Next steps for LynxBank:
1) Confirm procurement contact and send DPA redlines to procurement@lynxbank.com.
2) Confirm whether EU residency is required for pilot or only for production.

I'll attach the MAP spreadsheet and the traceability template here. Jordan — let me know when you open the DPA thread and I'll add legal to the loop.

Best,
Sean Gallagher
Senior Account Executive | Redwood Inference
